{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders, as they do not contribute to revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for confounding
ct = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])

# Check the distribution of customer segments across channels
